protocol: 60 min at 40% VO2peak then 30 min constant load and Wingate sets (0.075 kg/kg) with water, glucose or trehalose drink (water = control); blood glucose and lactate at stated time points given in text
population: healthy recreationally trained college male students (n per part in Methods)
note: Water trial is the control but drinks follow the first Wingate set; values are quoted in text for chosen time points, curves are in figures.
